mechanism: Naltrexone blocks opioid receptors and may potentiate monoamine oxidase inhibitor effects, while isocarboxazid increases synaptic monoamines creating risk for serotonergic syndrome and unpredictable CNS effects.
action: Avoid concurrent use; if naltrexone is necessary for opioid use disorder, use alternative antidepressant or ensure adequate washout period (14 days minimum after isocarboxazid discontinuation) with close monitoring.
